ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the image is a “statistical table of economic growth conditions of some provinces and municipalities in China in 2011.” The header lists regions in sequence, including Tianjin, Shanghai, Hunan, Hubei, Sichuan, Chongqing, Inner Mongolia, Shaanxi, and Guizhou; the table has two rows, “GDP(100 million yuan)” and “growth rate(%).” Then reason: find the “Guizhou” column in the header, look down along that column to the “growth rate(%)” row, and read that Guizhou's economic growth rate in 2011 was 15%. The growth rates of other regions in the table include Shanghai 8.2%, Hunan 12.8%, Hubei 13.8%, Shaanxi 13.9%, Sichuan 15%, Inner Mongolia 15%, Tianjin 16.4%, and Chongqing 16.4%. Guizhou's 15% is higher than that of multiple regions and is at a relatively high level, so Guizhou's economic growth rate in 2011 was relatively fast.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中是一张2011年我国部分省、市经济增长状况统计表，列出天津、上海、湖南、湖北、四川、重庆、内蒙古、陕西、贵州等地区，行包括GDP和增速。解题时先在表头找到“贵州”，再沿该列向下读“增速(%)”一行，得到贵州增速为15%。把15%与表中其他地区增速比较，发现它高于上海、湖南、湖北、陕西等，和四川、内蒙古相当，仅低于天津、重庆的16.4%，因此判断贵州2011年的经济增长速度较快。
